summary: Implemented the Databricks OAuth profile mapping, not run. Added cosmos/profiles/databricks/oauth.py with DatabricksOauthProfileMapping (required fields host, schema, client_secret, client_id, http_path; secret fields client_id and client_secret; login/extra.client_id and password/extra.client_secret sources; profile sets auth_type oauth and env-var refs for both secrets). Registered it directly after the token mapping in profile_mappings and added it to the exports in cosmos/profiles/__init__.py and cosmos/profiles/databricks/__init__.py. Added tests/profiles/databricks/test_dbr_oauth.py covering claim, token-vs-OAuth selection, profile output, and env vars, with the connection lookup patched. The env-var test asserts only the client secret value, not the plaintext client id. Tests were not run and nothing was committed.
